audit_items.proof_trace: The deposit function sequentially calls handle_mint (L49) and update_obligation_reward_manager (L51-57) with no conditional branch between them; handle_mint is public(package) with a single caller (deposit.move:49), so no path can execute the deposit while bypassing the reward update. If the reward pool is uninitialized for the CoinType, get_reward_manager_mut aborts and the entire transaction reverts, preserving atomicity even on failure.
